title: 有馬記念の後に・振り向かぬ背

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder finishes the race with splendid results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it seems Maruzensky's absence is still weighing on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky feels ignored, admitting frustration at how dismissive Grass Wonder is of the rivals right in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only then does Grass Wonder realize she hasn't truly clashed with her contemporaries.
